description:
Custom Start

Download

Git repository

Features

Add a custom start that allow you to choose the starting ships from a predefined set.
I encourage you  to ajust the ship you want. you can edit the rules.csv with a text editor, modify the lines like this and , in this exemple, replace shrike_Attack by another ship found in starsector-core\data\variant
ngcModAncienExplorerflagDoom,NewGameOptionSelected,$option == ngcModAncienExplorerflagDoom,"NGCAddShip doom_Attack
If you also want to modify the name displayed, few line before it you will find a text like this (change "Doom phase cruiser") : 
2:ngcModAncienExplorerflagDoom:Doom phase cruiser

Requirements

None

Compatibility

Compatible with all mod except mod that change the start.

I added the new game choice in postion 8, the game will ajust th number by itself

I should be compatible with futur version

You can remove it without problem in an existing save.

Notes

It's my first mod, don't hesite to comment about it.

It is fairly simple to modify the mod to add the ship that you want, you have all the variant name in the directory starsector-core\data\variants

You should be abble to put the name of variant added by other mods

Changelog

1.0 first version

1.1 :

Support version 0.98

Fix the forced medium difficulty to be able to choose the difficulty.

Add a 2k supply possibility

Add the possibilty to have an officier.

expend the description to help ajust the mod by the user.

aiDescription: Adds a custom start option that allows players to choose starting ships from a predefined set. The mod includes a rules.csv file that can be edited to modify available ships and their display names. It supports version 0.98 and allows for custom supply levels and officer selection.
